title: Warehouse stock with optimistic locking: version checks that stop working after the first hundred edits
name: Stock version check

questions.prompt: Warehouse staff adjust stock through the admin screen, which sends the version it last saw as If-Match. New SKUs work fine, but busy SKUs start answering 409 Conflict to perfectly valid edits, and nobody else has touched them. It only happens once a SKU has been edited a lot. Fix StockRepository.java so the tests pass.
